newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to bid for World Trade Expo 2002.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to bid for World Trade Expo 2002.

text.p: The Philippines will bid to host the World Trade Exposition in 2002, the presidential palace said on Saturday.

"President Fidel Ramos gave tourism secretary Mina Gabor the green light to make a formal presentation (to the expo committee) of the government's intention to host the event," the palace statement said.
The country planned to hold the exposition in Manila and the neighbouring Clark and Subic free port zones.
The proposed theme would centre on ecotourism, a growing concept in the tourism industry which emphasises preservation of the environment, it added.
Manila held an international trade fair in 1954.
